data.name: Jilaal
data.gender_notes: Jilaal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'jilal' which means thunderbolt, a symbol of power and protection from the heavens. It also represents the strength and might of Allah. The name Jilaal carries the meaning “thunderbolt, lightning” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jilaal usually hope their child will grow to embody thunderbolt, lightning and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the power and protection of Allah, inspiring strength and courage in those who bear it.
data.etymology: Jilaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “thunderbolt, lightning.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jilaal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: جلال
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جلال مشتق من الجلالة، ويعني العظمة والكبرياء الإلهية، وهو من أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام، ويستخدم لتعبير عن عظمة الله تعالى وجلاله. وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "وَلِلَّهِ الْجَلَالُ وَالْإِكْرَامُ".

in_urdu.name: جلال
in_urdu.meaning: جلال کا مطلب ہے الہی عظمت و شان
in_urdu.long_meaning: جلال ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے الہی عظمت و شان۔ یہ نام اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ اس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ: "وَلِلَّهِ الْجَلَالُ وَالْإِكْرَامُ"۔

in_hindi.name: जलाल
in_hindi.meaning: जलाल का अर्थ है ईश्वरीय महानता और प्रतिष्ठा
in_hindi.long_meaning: जलाल एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है ईश्वरीय महानता और प्रतिष्ठा। यह नाम अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है और इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है। इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी आया है, जैसे कि: "وَلِلَّهِ الْجَلَالُ وَالْإِكْرَامُ"।

in_pashto.name: جلال
in_pashto.meaning: جلال د الهي عظمت او شان معنی دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: جلال د عربي نوم دی چې د الهي عظمت او شان معنی دی. دا نوم د الله ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی او په اسلامي کلتور کې ډير اهميت لري. دا نوم په قرآن کريم کې هم ذکر شوی دی، لکه: "وَلِلَّهِ الْجَلَالُ وَالْإِكْرَامُ"۔

in_english.name: Jilaal
in_english.meaning: Means divine majesty, glory, and greatness in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Jilaal is derived from the Arabic root 'ج-ل-ل' which signifies grandeur, majesty, and divine greatness. It is one of the beautiful names of Allah in Islam, mentioned in the Quran as 'el-Celâl'. The name implies attributes of magnificence, honor, and reverence. Historically, it has been used to reflect the divine attributes of sublimity and grandeur.

In many Islamic communities, the name is associated with strength, courage, and protection from the heavens. The name can also be linked to the idea of divinely-given power and the awe-inspiring display of natural phenomena like thunderstorms, further emphasizing the idea of strength and power.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jilaal is a reminder of the power and might of Allah. It is believed that Allah grants His servants the strength and courage they need to face life's challenges, just as a thunderbolt strikes with unexpected force. The name also carries the idea of protection and guidance from Allah, as if He is watching over His servant like a protective shield. Overall, the name Jilaal is a source of strength and inspiration, reminding the bearer of the power and protection of Allah.
